# Inglis & Jane

- [Inglis](../character/inglis.md) — Spouse of — [Jane](../character/jane.md) — husband and wife · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Weddings P35](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0035), [v3 ch.Time P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) to go for a walk, but she must prepare for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next afternoon, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) walk to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes to her again. [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts, and they share their mutual feelings and clarify past misunderstandings before walking home engaged.
